title: Define one stable sheet position order
description: Create one documented pure ordering function for sheet positions and require assignment, availability, preview, pagination, and PDF planning to consume it.
acceptanceCriteria: The stable order is explicitly documented in terms of rows, columns, and the shared coordinate system
One pure function returns stable position identities for a validated sheet-layout revision
Assignment, availability, preview, pagination, and PDF planning do not define competing sort logic
Equivalent layout revisions produce the same position order over repeated runs and reloads
Invalid or duplicate positions return structured geometry diagnostics

steps.details: Choose the existing geometry convention, state its row/column traversal and tie behavior, and identify every current consumer with local ordering logic.
Derive stable position identities from validated immutable sheet geometry without locale, object insertion order, or viewport dependence.
Replace assignment, availability, preview, pagination-plan, and PDF-plan ordering seams with the shared result while preserving consumer-specific filtering.
Assert order for representative grids, repeated runs, serialized reloads, and duplicate/invalid geometry refusal.

technicalNotes: Timebox to extracting and wiring one ordering function; do not add user-configurable ordering in this requirement.
Position order is a software convention and makes no claim about printer feed direction.
